text:
lara: Quick question for managers — can we assemble a tiny 'handover + goal exemplar bank' for the upcoming midcycle reviews? I want something paste-ready that a manager can hand to a new owner or pop in a self-review. Short please.
alex: +1. can we make one line for outcome, one line for metric, one line for blocker/ask? super easy to skim. :thumbsup:
sam: love that. maybe two variants: 1) for project-driven goals, 2) for craftsmanship/people goals.
lara: yes — exactly. rough draft below, feel free to copy/paste and improve.
jen: dropping some manager-ready snippets i use in 1:1s. these are great for handoffs.
kevin: if we add a tiny checklist that managers tick when handing off, that might reduce followups. e.g., ownership, ops doc link, accepted perf impact.
hr-bot: Reminder: self-review window opens next Monday. See https://intranet/redwood/self-review for timeline and calibration dates.
lara: Draft exemplar bank (paste into reviews or a new owner handover):

```
Project goal (outcome-focused):
- Outcome: Delivered [feature] that enabled [user/business outcome]
- Signal: Increased [metric] by [X%] / reduced [latency/cost] by [Y%]
- Manager note (handover): Current status: [alpha/beta/prod], next steps: [A,B], blockers: [list]. Owner: @NAME. Docs: [link]

People/craft goal (growth/enablement):
- Outcome: Improved team reliability/review quality/onboarding speed by [what]
- Signal: Reduced incident MTTx by [X] / increased PR review throughput by [Y]%
- Manager note (handover): Career focus: [skill/behavior], suggested stretch projects: [ideas], peer mentors: [names]

One-line progress update (pasteable):
- Progress: [concise status — e.g., "80% complete; rollout scheduled 04/15; blocked on infra quota"]

Manager handoff checklist (tick when done):
- [ ] Ownership assigned in tracker (link)
- [ ] Runbook / docs linked
- [ ] Key metrics dashboards shared
- [ ] Onboarding quick call scheduled (15–30m)
- [ ] Known blockers & contacts documented
```

alex: these are gold. can we add a tiny template for "how to write your self-review bullet"? most engineers over/under-share.
lara: yes — a short scaffold below.

```
Self-review micro-scaffold (3 bullets, one-line each):
1) What I shipped: [feature/initiative] -> impact [metric or user outcome]
2) Where i pushed: [process/quality/ownership change] -> impact or what changed
3) Next focus / ask: [what you want from manager/org: support, headcount, unblocker]
```

sam: i like the ask being explicit — helps calibration.
jen: can we also include a canned manager comment for calibration meetings? short and factual.

lara: yep — manager calibration snippets:

```
Manager calibration snippets (pasteable):
- Strong contributor: "Consistently delivered high-impact work; drove X -> Y; shows strong ownership and collaboration."
- Needs development: "Delivered on goals but inconsistent cross-team communication; recommended focused coaching on stakeholder alignment."
- Promotion-ready (high level): "Repeatedly exceeded scope and impact; expanded influence across teams; ready for broader responsibility."
```

kevin: tiny ask — can we make this a single page in the handbook and a short Slack thread linkable in the review form? avoids hunting around.
lara: will add to handbook and attach link to review form. thanks everyone. if you want to tweak wording, reply here and i'll fold into the doc before Monday. :sparkles:
